integrity: The universal count is proved analytically via character-column types and three-matchings in a subdirect bipartite graph; exact finite enumeration is used only as a replay check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to pairs of three-element subsets of binary vector spaces; it does not address larger subsets, odd characteristic, arbitrary finite abelian groups, or Riesz-ratio optimization.
title: Exact three-point simultaneous exponential bases in binary vector spaces
